name: Jellyfish Mastery I
description: Jellyfish moods now grant an additional effect. Sad restores Mana, Sleepy restores HP, Curious awards Star Candies, Confident deals bonus damage, and Dedicated deals even more bonus damage.

moods.activationLine: Jellyfish Mastery activates! The Jellyfish looks devastated by its performance. You tell it that it did a wonderful job. It perks up immediately and somehow gives you 20 Mana. Apparently encouragement is a renewable resource.
Jellyfish Mastery activates! The Jellyfish yawns, floats over, and falls asleep directly on your head. You recover 20 HP. You're not entirely sure this is medicine.
Jellyfish Mastery activates! The Jellyfish wanders off to investigate something shiny and returns with 50 Star Candies. You decide not to ask where it found them.
Jellyfish Mastery activates! The Jellyfish looks extremely pleased with itself and immediately goes back for another bonk. +5 damage.
Jellyfish Mastery activates! The Jellyfish looks at you. It looks at your foe. It gives a tiny, determined wobble and charges back in. +8 damage.
